beats.say: 4 days: Apollo 13 crew survived a terrifying disaster using just a pencil
That is less than a working week, using just a pencil and slide rule to stay alive
The mission was commanded by Jim Lovell, with Jack Swigert and Fred Haise on board
An oxygen tank exploded two days in, forcing the crew to transfer to the Lunar Module
Mission Control improvised new procedures to support three men for four days of extreme hardship
All three survived, looped the Moon and splashed down safely in the South Pacific

meta.title: Time Machine #1: Apollo 13: the pencil detail they held back 🚀
meta.alt_title: Jim Lovell's Apollo 13 crew: the pencil twist 🚀
meta.summary: The Apollo 13 crew survived an explosion in space using a pencil and slide rule. They transferred to the Lunar Module and Mission Control improvised new procedures to support them.
meta.comment: Could you have stayed calm on Apollo 13 with only a pencil and slide rule?
facts: The mission was commanded by Jim Lovell, with Jack Swigert as command module pilot and Fred Haise as Lunar Module pilot.
An oxygen tank in the service module exploded two days into the mission.
The crew transferred to the Lunar Module as a lifeboat.
Mission Control in Houston improvised new procedures so the Lunar Module could support three men for four days.
According to Wikipedia, the crew survived, looping around the Moon, and splashed down safely in the South Pacific.
